stops.name: Lake Brienz
stops.quote: Discover Lake Brienz along with the Giessbach Falls and the Brienzer Rothorn.
stops.english: Discover Lake Brienz along with the Giessbach Falls and the Brienzer Rothorn.

stops.name: Giessbach Falls
stops.quote: The top excursion destination on Lake Brienz is the Giessbach Falls: you travel by boat from Brienz to Giessbach station, and from there you’ll take the nostalgic funicular up to the Grandhotel Giessbach.
stops.english: The top excursion destination on Lake Brienz is the Giessbach Falls: you travel by boat from Brienz to Giessbach station, and from there you’ll take the nostalgic funicular up to the Grandhotel Giessbach.

stops.name: Brienzer Rothorn
stops.quote: Between June and October, experience a ride on the historic steam-powered cog railway to the Brienzer Rothorn.
stops.english: Between June and October, experience a ride on the historic steam-powered cog railway to the Brienzer Rothorn.

stops.name: Brunngasse
stops.quote: Brunngasse, with its cobblestones and its wooden chalets decorated with flowers and carvings, is a must-see.
stops.english: Brunngasse, with its cobblestones and its wooden chalets decorated with flowers and carvings, is a must-see.

stops.name: Schnitzlerweg
stops.quote: You can also marvel at the art of wood carving on the Schnitzlerweg woodcarving trail on the Axalp above Brienz.
stops.english: You can also marvel at the art of wood carving on the Schnitzlerweg woodcarving trail on the Axalp above Brienz.

stops.name: Hinterburgseeli
stops.quote: Perhaps with a detour to the enchanting Hinterburgseeli lake along the way.
stops.english: Perhaps with a detour to the enchanting Hinterburgseeli lake along the way.

stops.name: Ballenberg - Open-air museum of Switzerland
stops.quote: Other top excursion destinations include the Ballenberg open-air museum, Lake Lunger, the Aare Gorge and the neighbouring Lake Thun.
stops.english: Other top excursion destinations include the Ballenberg open-air museum, Lake Lunger, the Aare Gorge and the neighbouring Lake Thun.
